core_obligations: The Bethe-Sommerfeld argument requires more than spectral asymptotics or the fact that the spectrum of a directsum is a union:the overlap function can collapse under directsum,as the authors explicitcounterexample shows. The new proof builds simultaneously good nonresonant shells for the component symbols,controls translatedshell intersections andresonant badsets,then uses a lattice pigeonhole/radialbranch counting argument to force a polynomiallower bound for a common orderedBloch-fibre spectralband. Uniform fibre counting/uncoupling estimates transfer this overlap to the coupled system without reopening high-energy gaps.
